Refactorings as code actions: the prototype of a function called before
the file defines it, put above the function of the first call; and the
path of the one file of the lib a missing #include may have meant, a
quick fix that is not preferred (it may not be the file meant).

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/include/std.h --
#define STD 1
-- lib/players/ann/defs.h --
#define ANN 1
-- lib/players/ann/obj/a.c --
#include "defs.h"

void f() {
    helper(1);
}

int helper(int n) { return n; }
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/players/ann/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/players/ann/obj/a.c
actions lib/players/ann/obj/a.c 0:12-0:12 quickfix
apply 0
actions lib/players/ann/obj/a.c 3:6-3:6
apply 0
actions lib/players/ann/obj/a.c 7:6-7:6 refactor
shutdown
exit
